home.title: Nice to meet you!
home.first: Hello. Just a grown-up kid<babyMe></babyMe> <firstNote>figuring things out.¹</firstNote> I’m a student at FIT, working toward product design. I love<catHeart></catHeart> <worldBuilding>world building</worldBuilding> since childhood.
home.second: My first art teacher was a DS game that taught me to paint <secondNote>an apple.²</secondNote> Traded pointe <pointeShoes>shoes</pointeShoes> for an overworked laptop.
home.third: Ask me about folk theory and <ghibli><emphasis>Hayao</emphasis> <miyazaki>Miyazaki!</miyazaki></ghibli> Oh, and let’s not forget <thirdNote>Patrick Bateman’s chair.³</thirdNote> Currently: pondering leftist edgelord <fingerHeart>culture</fingerHeart> and unapologetically looking up NYT crossword <crossword>answers.</crossword>
